mechanism_narrative: A high effective federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) and high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signal stagflation risks, causing equity investors to demand higher risk premiums and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle recession, declining housing starts below 1400 thousand units signal deteriorating residential construction and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle recessions when HOUST < 1400

mechanism_narrative: A low industrial production index below 100 signals a contraction in manufacturing output and weak economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls below 155,000 signals weak job growth and reduced household income, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 155000

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) and retail sales (RSAFS < 690,000) indicates a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 690000

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market and strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%
